limitations: One VM, synthetic warm-cache direct APIs, bounded closed-loop load, fresh process and fixture per run. Each operation reads and updates two checksummed values atomically; SQLite uses WAL, synchronous=FULL and BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Prototype modes use synchronized optimistic transactions and explicitly retry conflicts. Checkpoint creation and all backend initialization happen outside the timer. SQLite's internal busy waiting is reflected in latency, not conflict counts. Implementations, storage and durability behavior differ; no physical power-loss or general competitor ranking is established. VM/cgroup noise includes setup, verification and cleanup.
